```{r}
#| label: merging-dfs

library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(tibble)
library(broom)
library(broom.mixed)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(readr)
library(kableExtra)

data_folder <- file.path(
  Sys.getenv("HOME"),
  "Desktop",
  "Independent Study Data",
  "memHit_Updated"
)

csv_files <- list.files(
  path = data_folder,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  recursive = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

memhit_task <- map_dfr(
  csv_files,
  ~ read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()))
)

MTQ <- read_csv(
  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), "Desktop", "Independent Study Data", "MTQ_Updated.csv")
) 

id_mappings <- readr::read_csv("id_mappings")

memhit_task <- memhit_task |>
  mutate(prolific_pid = as.character(participant))

MTQ <- MTQ |>
  filter(!is.na(participant)) |>
  mutate(prolific_pid = as.character(participant),
         prolific_pid = sub("^0", "", prolific_pid))


id_mappings <- id_mappings |>
  mutate(
    participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
    prolific_pid = as.character(prolific_pid)
  )


fix_ids <- function(x) {
  mapping_row <- match(x, id_mappings$participant_id)
  matched <- !is.na(mapping_row)

  x[matched] <- id_mappings$prolific_pid[mapping_row[matched]]

  return(x)
}

MTQ$prolific_pid <- fix_ids(MTQ$prolific_pid)

merged_data <- memhit_task |>
  inner_join(MTQ, by = "prolific_pid")
```

```{r}
#| label: cleaning-master-df

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  select(contains("QID6_"),
         prolific_pid,
         Progress,
         `Duration (in seconds)`,
         Finished,
         expCondition,
         boxType,
         outcomeType,
         outcome,
         rewardAmount,
         rewardType,
         rewardProb,
         total_earnings_final,
         avg_report_accuracy,
         hitTask_duration,
         rating_pink,
         rating_blue,
         rating_yellow,
         globalTrial,
         firstPressTime,
         press_count,
         active_press_threshold
         ) |>
  mutate(
  across(
    starts_with("QID6_"),
    ~ .x |>
      as.character() |>
      na_if("n/a (Prefer not to answer)") |>
      stringr::str_extract("\\d+") |>
      as.numeric()
  )
) |>
  filter(!is.na(prolific_pid))
  

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  mutate(personal_mastery = QID6_20 + QID6_14 + QID6_39 + QID6_9 + 
           QID6_21 + QID6_46 + (6 - QID6_40) + QID6_15 + QID6_2 + QID6_28,
         competitive_excellence = QID6_41 + QID6_16 + QID6_29 + QID6_23 +
           QID6_35 + QID6_3 + QID6_4 + (6 - QID6_17) + QID6_10 + QID6_30 + (6 -   QID6_11) + (6 - QID6_24),
         achievement_anxiety = QID6_42 + QID6_50 + QID6_19 + QID6_48 + (6 - QID6_44) + (6 - QID6_12) +
           QID6_47 + QID6_37 + QID6_49,
         mtq_total = achievement_anxiety + personal_mastery + competitive_excellence) |>
  filter(!is.na(personal_mastery | competitive_excellence | achievement_anxiety))

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  mutate(expCondition = na_if(expCondition, "")) |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  fill(expCondition, .direction = "down") |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(EV = as.numeric(rewardAmount) * as.numeric(rewardProb)) |>
  mutate(
    reward_level = case_when(
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 0.3 ~ "low_p30",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 0.3 ~ "high_p30",
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 0.7 ~ "low_p70",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 0.7 ~ "high_p70",
      rewardType %in% "L" & rewardProb == 1 ~ "low_p100",
      rewardType %in% "H" & rewardProb == 1 ~ "high_p100",
    ))


```

```{r}
mtq_scoring <- merged_data |>
  select(personal_mastery,
         competitive_excellence,
         achievement_anxiety,
         mtq_total,
         prolific_pid) |>
  distinct() |>
  filter(!is.na(personal_mastery | competitive_excellence | achievement_anxiety))
```

```{r}
#| label: EDA
#| warning: FALSE

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  group_by(prolific_pid) |>
  mutate(prop_press = as.numeric(press_count)/as.numeric(active_press_threshold)) |>
  mutate(
    competitive_excellence = first(competitive_excellence),
    personal_mastery = first(personal_mastery),
    achievement_anxiety = first(achievement_anxiety)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(!is.na(reward_level)) |>
  mutate(
    reward_level = factor(
      reward_level,
      levels = c(
        "high_p100", "low_p100",
        "high_p70",  "low_p70",
        "high_p30",  "low_p30"
      )
    ))

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  mutate(
    competitive_excellence_z =
      as.numeric(scale(competitive_excellence)),
    personal_mastery_z =
      as.numeric(scale(personal_mastery)),
    achievement_anxiety_z =
      as.numeric(scale(achievement_anxiety)),
    mtq_total_z = 
      as.numeric(scale(mtq_total)),
    active_press_threshold_z =
      as.numeric(scale(as.numeric(active_press_threshold)))
  )

#would be nice to stratify this by experimental group once we get more data...
#add facet_wrap(~expCondition) to all plot when you want to stratify 

plot <- function(x){
  ggplot(merged_data,
    aes(
       x = {{x}},
      y = prop_press,
      group = reward_level,
      color = reward_level,
      linetype = reward_level
    )
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Reward level",
    values = c(
      high_p100 = "blue",
      low_p100 = "blue",
      high_p70 = "green4",
      low_p70 = "green4",
      high_p30 = "goldenrod3",
      low_p30 = "goldenrod3"
    )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Reward level",
    values = c(
      high_p100 = "solid",
      low_p100 = "dashed",
      high_p70 = "solid",
      low_p70 = "dashed",
      high_p30 = "solid",
      low_p30 = "dashed"
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw()}

plot(personal_mastery)
plot(competitive_excellence)
plot(achievement_anxiety)

```
```{r}
#| label: significance
#| warning: FALSE


# COMPETITIVE EXCELLENCE

model_ce <-  lmer(
  prop_press ~ competitive_excellence_z * reward_level +
    (1 | prolific_pid),
  data = merged_data) 

 tidy_model_ce <- tidy(
  model_ce,
  effects = "fixed",
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
 
  tidy_model_ce  |>
    kable(digits = 3)

#PERSONAL MASTERY

model_pm <-  lmer(
  prop_press ~ personal_mastery_z * reward_level +
    (1 | prolific_pid),
  data = merged_data) 

 tidy_model_pm <- tidy(
  model_pm,
  effects = "fixed",
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
 
  tidy_model_pm  |>
    kable(digits = 3)


#ACHIEVEMENT ANXIETY

model_aa <-  lmer(
  prop_press ~ achievement_anxiety_z * reward_level +
    (1 | prolific_pid),
  data = merged_data) 

 tidy_model_aa <- tidy(
  model_aa,
  effects = "fixed",
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
 
  tidy_model_aa  |>
    kable(digits = 3)

#acounting for active_press_threshold
  
adjusted_model_mtq_total <- lmer(
  prop_press ~ mtq_total_z * reward_level +
    active_press_threshold_z + 
    (1 | prolific_pid), data = merged_data)

tidy_adjusted_mtq_total <- tidy(
  adjusted_model_mtq_total,
  effects = "fixed",
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high)
 
tidy_adjusted_mtq_total  |>
    kable(digits = 3)

threshold_row <- which(
  tidy_adjusted_mtq_total$term == "active_press_threshold_z"
)

tidy_adjusted_mtq_total |>
  kable(digits = 3) |>
  row_spec(
    row = threshold_row,
    bold = TRUE,
    background = "#FFF2CC"
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: correlation-matrix

trait_cor <- merged_data |>
  select(
    prolific_pid,
    competitive_excellence_z,
    personal_mastery_z,
    achievement_anxiety_z
  ) |>
  distinct(prolific_pid, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  select(-prolific_pid)

trait_complete <- trait_cor[complete.cases(trait_cor), ]

p_matrix_mtq <- cor_pmat(trait_complete)
p_matrix_mtq


corr_matrix_mtq <- cor(trait_cor, use = "complete.obs")

ggcorrplot(corr_matrix_mtq,
           lab = TRUE,
           colors = c("#efefef", "#9f9f9f", "#5f5f5f"),
           ggtheme = theme_minimal())
```
